facts.fact: LesEco.ma reports Minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni presenting the 'AI Made in Morocco' strategy, built on three pillars and 18 priority sectors, at an event in Rabat.

LesEco.ma reports the creation of the Jazari Institutes network of centres of excellence, led by Jazari Root, as a strategic pillar of the Morocco 2030 strategy to build lasting national AI capacity for the state.
